title: Corpus Christi Saltwater Fishing Charters
blurb: Guests fish inshore bays around Corpus Christi including Laguna Madre, Baffin Bay, Corpus Christi Bay, Oso Bay, Shamrock Cove, and The Land Cut. Fishing methods include live bait, artificial lures, and drift fishing from the boat. Wade fishing trips are available upon request.
extraNote: Usually launches out of Clems Marina, approximately 15 minutes from Port Aransas or 20 minutes from Portland.
meetingPoint: Usually launches out of Clems Marina, approximately 15 minutes from Port Aransas or 20 minutes from Portland.
